title: Enclose a conditional product-Poisson normalizer with a fully paid finite algorithm
statement: Let w(x)=product c_i^x_i/x_i!,w0=w(x0)>0,U=3^ceil(sum c_i), and integer M>=max_i{x0_i,2c_i}. The full-orthant outside-box weight is <=r_M=2U sum_i c_i^(M+1)/(M+1)!. Increase M by exact rational arithmetic until r_M<=delta*w0, then enumerate[0,M]^d, use ordinary-ideal class membership and sum Z_M exactly. This terminates with w0<=Z_M<=Z_Gamma<=Z_M+r_M and relative interval width<=delta. All enumeration, Groebner, factorial, rare-conditioning and encoding costs have finite computable complete-input bounds; none is assumed polynomial. The recorded c=1,A<->2A,x0=1,delta=10^-6 fixture gives M=10,Zlower=6235301/3628800,Zupper=9798331/5702400 and width1/6652800; it is corroboration, not a spectral theorem.
